description: LAFU Search automatic extras: when the monthly allowance and prepaid credit run out, keep searching and pay per use (VAT included: EUR 0.20 per 1,000 searches, EUR 1 per 1,000 voice searches, EUR 2 per 1,000 photo searches; Pro and Scale only). action get (default; each kind with offered, on, price and uses this month) or set (kind search, voice or photo + on true/false). set needs confirm.

action.description: get is default; set needs confirm.

on.description: set: true turns automatic extras on, false off.

site.description: LAFU Search site: OMA id or domain. Optional when the account has one site.

name: oma_pika_extras
title: LAFU Search automatic extras
